preconditions.description: The number of good letters is between 1 and 26.
All characters in good_letters are lowercase English letters.
The length of the pattern is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() or c == '?' or c == '*' for c in pattern)
preconditions.description: The pattern consists of lowercase English letters, '?', and '*'.
The pattern contains at most one '*'.
The number of query strings is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(query) <= 10**5 for query in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query string has a length between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c.islower() for c in query) for query in queries)
preconditions.description: All characters in each query string are lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the number of query strings.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] in ['YES', 'NO'] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((pattern_matches(pattern, queries[i], good_letters) if output[i] == 'YES' else not pattern_matches(pattern, queries[i], good_letters)) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each query string, the output is 'YES' if the pattern matches the query string using the good letters, and 'NO' otherwise.
